Full-Stack QA Engineer
 Location: Fully remote 
 Reports to: QA Lead
 We’re looking for a QA Engineer to own quality across assigned areas of a financial trading product. The role combines hands-on manual testing, test automation, and release validation. Familiarity with forex, crypto, or trading is required.

Responsibilities
• Test features end to end, including functional, integration, API, regression, and exploratory testing.
• Review requirements and acceptance criteria for gaps, unclear behavior, and quality risks.
• Build and maintain E2E tests in TypeScript/JavaScript with Playwright and API integration tests in Python.
• Investigate failing or flaky tests and improve automation reliability.
• Work with developers, product managers, and the QA Lead to resolve issues.
• Validate releases and communicate outstanding risks before deployment.
• Use approved AI tools where they improve testing quality or efficiency.

Requirements
• Practical experience testing web applications, both manually and through automation.
• Experience with Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript for E2E testing, and Python for API integration testing.
• Familiarity with forex, crypto, or trading products and concepts.
• Ability to work independently, prioritize competing tasks, and take ownership of quality beyond individual test cases.
• Clear written communication and attention to detail.
• Native-level Russian and English at B2 level or above.

Hiring process
1. Interview with the QA Lead and Product Owner.
 2. Final interview with the CTO.
